claim: llm-d's v0.8 release (target Jun 21 2026, closed Jun 23 2026) shipped a first-party non-Kubernetes deployment mode for the router, built as a pluggable DiscoveryPlugin interface in llm-d-router with a concrete FileDiscovery plugin that loads backend definitions from YAML/JSON and watches for changes via fsnotify.
stance_target: llm-d already has an official, merged mechanism for routing to non-Kubernetes-discovered backends, directly relevant to the user's customization goal
quoted_support: Non-Kubernetes deployment mode - https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d/blob/main/docs/proposals/non-kubernetes-mode.md ... feat: Add pluggable DiscoveryPlugin interface - llm-d-router#908 ... file-discovery (3/4): add FileDiscovery plugin with YAML/JSON file loading and fsnotify watch - llm-d-router#1135

claim: The FileDiscovery implementation was built as a four-part PR sequence: (1) DiscoveryBackendStore interface with BackendUpsert/Delete methods and NewDiscoveryNotifier (llm-d-router#1080, #1081), (2) the FileDiscovery plugin itself with YAML/JSON loading and fsnotify watching (llm-d-router#1135), (3) a naming cleanup renaming BackendUpsert/Delete and DiscoveryBackendStore (llm-d-router#1154), and (4) wiring the FileDiscovery plugin into the router's runner/binary entrypoint (llm-d-router#1218), followed by fixes for gRPC size parameters, Flow Control integration, and datalayer notification dispatch.
stance_target: concrete implementation sequence a router-customization project would replicate or extend
quoted_support: file-discovery-1: add BackendUpsert/Delete interface methods and extract upertEndpoint helper - llm-d-router#1080 ... filediscovery-2: add DiscoveryBackendStore interface, NewDiscoveryNotifier - llm-d-router#1081 ... FileDiscovery plugin (4/4) - wiring into the runner - llm-d-router#1218 ... epp: wire FlowControl into file-discovery mode - llm-d-router#1368 ... fix(datalayer): dispatch endpoint update notifications - llm-d-router#1404
